class.name: SimpleComputeUpscaler
class.brief_description: Minimal built-in compute upscaler for testing custom viewport hooks.
class.description: A diagnostic nearest-sample compute pass. It is not FSR and does not perform temporal reconstruction. Assign it to a viewport in [constant Viewport.SCALING_3D_MODE_CUSTOM].

method.name: get_dispatch_count
method.description: Returns the number of successful upscaling dispatches.
